clue.text: Picking up on insurance policy, finally

parts.note: RE means 'on' or 'concerning', as in a letter heading
insurance is cover, protection against loss

indicators.note: finally asks for the closing letter of the word policy

explanation.surface: Someone is getting hold of an insurance policy at last.
explanation.definitionFit: A market or patient that is picking up is on the mend, in a state of improvement.

clue.text: Long letter initially ignored

indicators.note: initially ignored means the opening letter of the spelt-out word is dropped

parts.note: the letter H is spelt out as aitch

explanation.surface: A lengthy piece of correspondence was at first left unread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Letter' is not a message but the name of the letter H, spelt AITCH; losing its A leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To long for something is to yearn, to be eager or impatient to do it; the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Is missing founder of order's Swiss currency

indicators.note: missing tells us the word Is goes absent from the saint's name

parts.note: St Francis of Assisi founded the Franciscan order of friars

explanation.surface: A saint's coinage is somehow absent, as if a monastic founder had his own Swiss money.
explanation.definitionFit: The franc is the monetary unit of Switzerland and Liechtenstein.

clue.text: Has time abroad bringing on lack of belief

indicators.note: abroad, meaning scattered far and wide, signals the letters of Has time are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: Spending time overseas leads someone to lose their faith.
explanation.definitionFit: Disbelief in any god is the defining position of the godless, an absence of religious faith.

clue.text: Be prone to tell fibs

definitions.meaning: to be prone is to rest flat, horizontal on a bed or the ground
to tell fibs is to say untrue things, to deceive

explanation.definitionFit: The same short verb means both to recline flat and to speak falsehoods.

clue.text: Guard to see later

parts.note: to see is to look
later means after, afterwards

explanation.surface: A sentry is told to check in at a later time.
explanation.definitionFit: To guard someone or something is to take care of it, keep it safe: a phrasal synonym.

clue.text: Does it matter who naughtily took a seat outside?

indicators.note: outside means the sitting word wraps around the jumbled letters

parts.note: took a seat means sat down

indicators.note: naughtily, as of misbehaving letters, signals that who is jumbled

explanation.surface: A querulous voice asks whether it really matters who mischievously sat down out there.
explanation.definitionFit: The dismissive retort is a shrug meaning the thing is unimportant, asking whether it matters at all.

clue.text: Passionate tale involving maidens

indicators.note: involving means the tale takes the letter inside itself

parts.note: a tale is a story
M is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for maidens, overs with no runs

explanation.surface: A romantic story full of young women in love.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a maiden is an over bowled without a run conceded; M stands for maidens in bowling figures.
explanation.definitionFit: A stormy relationship is passionate, full of violent emotion like turbulent weather.

clue.text: Advocate putting obstacle across street

indicators.note: across means the obstacle word is laid over and either side of the street letters

parts.note: an obstacle is a barrier

explanation.surface: A lawyer is blocking the road with a barricade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Advocate' looks like a verb in the surface, but it is the noun for a courtroom lawyer.
explanation.definitionFit: In British law an advocate who pleads in the higher courts is a barrister, a type of lawyer.

clue.text: Cause harm to planet, endlessly

indicators.note: endlessly means the planet's name loses its final letter

parts.note: Mars is the fourth planet from the sun

explanation.surface: Humanity is told off for damaging the Earth without end.
explanation.definitionFit: To spoil or damage something is to impair it, a synonym for harming it.

clue.text: Singer, making love in corner, collapsed

indicators.note: collapsed suggests a structure falling apart, so the letters are broken up and rebuilt

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A vocalist cuddling in a corner suddenly keels over.
explanation.definitionFit: A crooner is a singer of sentimental ballads in a soft, smooth style, like Bing Crosby.

clue.text: Important area around North African country

indicators.note: around means the important-area letters wrap themselves about the compass letter

parts.note: key means important, crucial
N is the compass abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: A key region near the north of Africa is being described.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface invites 'North African' as one phrase, but North is only the letter N and the country is in East Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Kenya is a nation on the east coast of Africa, capital Nairobi.

clue.text: Greek goddess shown in lexicon I kept

indicators.note: shown in says the letters are on display inside the run of words lexicon I kept

explanation.surface: A classicist kept a dictionary featuring a Greek deity.
explanation.definitionFit: Nike was the winged Greek goddess of victory.

clue.text: Nanny sure went mad

indicators.note: mad, meaning crazed, signals that the letters of sure went go wild into a new order

explanation.surface: A nanny is quite certain she went crazy.
explanation.definitionFit: A wet nurse is a woman employed to suckle another's baby, an old kind of nursemaid.

clue.text: Draws founder of Singapore

definitions.meaning: draws are lotteries where tickets are pulled for prizes
Sir Stamford ... founded modern Singapore in 1819

explanation.definitionFit: Lottery-style prize draws share the name of the British colonial official Stamford Raffles.

clue.text: Finish last in race in trial

indicators.note: the second in places that letter inside the trial word

parts.note: a trial is a court case

indicators.note: last in picks the final letter of the word race

explanation.surface: Someone finishing last in a race finds themselves on trial.
explanation.definitionFit: To cease is to stop or come to an end, a synonym for finishing.

clue.text: Trouble during holiday causes indecision

indicators.note: during means the trouble occurs inside the holiday word

parts.note: a holiday is a vacation
ill as a noun means trouble or misfortune

explanation.surface: Problems on holiday leave someone unable to make up their mind.
explanation.definitionFit: Vacillation is wavering between options, the state of being unable to decide.

clue.text: Head of serious crime discounted motive

indicators.note: Head of points at the leading letter of the crime word
discounted means that leading letter is left out of the reckoning

parts.note: treason, betraying one's country, is a grave crime

explanation.surface: A detective dismissed the chief of a major crime as having no motive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Head of serious' tempts as S, but the head belongs to the whole 'serious crime', TREASON.
explanation.definitionFit: A reason for an action is the motive or cause behind it.

clue.text: Dicky writes about onset of terrible tornado

indicators.note: about means the jumbled letters go round that opening letter
dicky is British slang for shaky or faulty, so writes is to be shaken up
onset of picks the opening letter of terrible

explanation.surface: A man called Dicky writes about the first signs of a dreadful storm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dicky' looks like a name but is slang for unsound; WRITES becomes WISTER with 'about' putting it round T, the onset of terrible.
explanation.definitionFit: Twister is an informal American word for a tornado, a violently rotating storm.

clue.text: Greek poet in centre of Paris

parts.note: being in means being at home

indicators.note: centre of picks the middle letter of the five-letter word Paris

explanation.surface: A Greek poet is found in the middle of the French capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in centre of Paris' reads as one location, but 'in' is a piece of its own: being in is being at home.
explanation.definitionFit: Homer was the ancient Greek epic poet credited with the Iliad and the Odyssey.

clue.text: Core smashed, crushed

parts.note: the core of something is its heart
something smashed is broken

explanation.surface: An apple core is smashed and squashed.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone crushed by a loss or rejection is devastated with grief, emotionally shattered.

clue.text: Magician in conflict over door fastening

indicators.note: over in a down clue puts the conflict word above the fastening

parts.note: a conflict is a war
a lock fastens a door

explanation.surface: A wizard is quarrelling about how a door is secured.
explanation.definitionFit: A warlock is a male witch or sorcerer, someone practising magic.

clue.text: For example, a cart overturned — something a caddy should know about

definitions.text: something a caddy should know about

indicators.note: overturned, like a tipped-up cart, says the pieces are read from the bottom up

parts.note: a dray is a low cart for heavy loads, such as beer barrels

explanation.surface: A golf caddy should know about a cart tipping over on the course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overturned' reverses EG A DRAY. In golf a caddy carries the clubs and advises on distances.
explanation.definitionFit: A golf caddy must know the distance in yards to the hole to advise on club choice.

clue.text: Staff, embracing start of Ramadan, go without food

indicators.note: embracing means the staff word holds that letter inside it

parts.note: a stave is a staff or stick

indicators.note: start of picks the opening letter of Ramadan

explanation.surface: Workers observing the beginning of the Muslim holy month fast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Staff' suggests employees but is a stick, STAVE.
explanation.definitionFit: To starve is to suffer or die from lack of nourishment, to have nothing to eat.

clue.text: Meat company breaking embargo

indicators.note: breaking means the company letters split the embargo word open

parts.note: an embargo is a ban on trade

explanation.surface: A meat company is defying a trade embargo.
explanation.definitionFit: Bacon is cured meat from the back or sides of a pig.

clue.text: Subordinate elected to interrupt more briefly

indicators.note: to interrupt means the elected word breaks into the shortened word
briefly means the word more is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: a party elected is in, in power

explanation.surface: A junior official, newly voted in, keeps cutting into discussion with short remarks.
explanation.definitionFit: A minor figure is lesser in rank or importance, subordinate to others.
